events.title: Salesforce.com launched
events.summary: Marc Benioff launched Salesforce.com on February 7, 2000 at the "End of Software" event — a browser-based CRM delivered as a subscription service.
events.about: Salesforce brought CRM to the cloud before "[SaaS]" was mainstream: accounts, contacts, opportunities, and reports in a browser with no on-prem install. Apex and the AppExchange later turned it into a platform; Heroku, MuleSoft, and Slack acquisitions expanded the ecosystem. It defined how enterprise software could be sold and extended online.

narrative.whyChosen: Salesforce proved large business apps could run entirely in the browser as multi-tenant [SaaS].
narrative.whyImportant: It pioneered subscription CRM and platform marketplaces that AWS-era startups copied.
narrative.problemSolved: On-prem CRM required expensive servers, consultants, and painful upgrade cycles.
